entities.summary: Bushy Bride is a Norwegian fairy tale collected by Peter Christen Asbjørnsen and Jørgen Moe. The tale is classified as Aarne–Thompson–Uther type 403, "The Black and the White Bride". It was included in Andrew Lang's Red Fairy Book (1890). According to Brynjulf Alver, Moe shaped Buskebrura from Telemark variants, publishing it in the first edition of Norske Folkeeventyr (1852). Archival manuscripts confirm an earlier version recorded by Moe in the 1840s titled Om Kalledatter og Kjærringdatter. A later Telemark variant was collected by Moltke Moe from storyteller Kari Staffsholt in 1878–80.
